text: Apple introduces a new, expanded Home initiative
full-pick-text: Apple introduces a new, expanded Home initiative. A "HomePod with a display" is introduced at $249. The Apple TV is updated with a remote that supports Find My. Apple talks about improved Thread support.
notes:
• A "HomePod with a display" is introduced at $249

  • Stephen's first Risky Pick candidate was about John Ternus introducing himself as CEO, but they got demoted to Flexies.
